report.summary: All 26 tests error during session setup because the app never starts: uvicorn exits with code 1 while importing app/main.py. The cause is a missing comma in the SQLite SCHEMA string (app/main.py:38-39), which makes the import-time schema creation fail. Fix that comma first, then rerun; no test code needs to change.

causes.title: Missing comma in books table DDL stops the app from starting
causes.explanation: The SCHEMA string in app/main.py defines the books table with no comma after the owner_id column, so the next token is 'title' and the DDL is invalid SQL. The schema is executed at import time (app/main.py:57-58: `with db() as _conn: _conn.executescript(SCHEMA)`), so importing app.main:app raises and uvicorn exits with code 1 before it serves /health. tests/conftest.py:_wait_until_up then sees proc.poll() != None and raises 'App exited early with code 1' in the session-scoped base_url fixture. Every test that depends on base_url (directly or through api, user, new_user, anon_api, other_api, or the UI fixtures) therefore errors at setup. The failure is deterministic and is in the application code, not in the CI machine or the test logic. The taxonomy lists 'the app could not start' under infrastructure, but this is a defect in the app's source, so I have classified it as product_bug. The subprocess stderr is not captured, so the SQLite syntax error itself was not seen in the CI log; the diagnosis rests on reading the code.
evidence: tests/conftest.py:35: raise RuntimeError(f"App exited early with code {proc.returncode}")
tests/conftest.py:58-62: subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--port", str(port), "--log-level", "warning"], cwd=ROOT, env=env) with stdout/stderr not redirected
app/main.py:36-39: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS books ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL / title TEXT NOT NULL, — no comma after 'owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL'
app/main.py:57-58: with db() as _conn: _conn.executescript(SCHEMA) — runs at module import, so a bad schema aborts app import
Failure detail for tests.api.test_auth_api::test_login_returns_token: 'RuntimeError: App exited early with code 1' from the base_url fixture
causes.suggested_fix: Add the missing comma in app/main.py so the books table reads `owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,`. Then run `python -c "import app.main"` locally, or start uvicorn by hand, to confirm the app imports and /health returns 200. Consider also having conftest capture the uvicorn stderr so the next startup failure shows its real message.
